title: The loading-bay slot moves to Tuesdays
setting: The front-desk coordinator of a small physiotherapy clinic (admin only: rooms, staff rotas, supplier orders)

events.text: From now on, any change to a confirmed supplier order worth $500 or more needs my sign-off before it goes back to the supplier. Smaller orders the front desk can adjust itself (delivery day or time), as long as the supplier is told.

Priya, the front-desk rota is yours. You can move the front-desk team's shifts yourself, as long as the person is told the new details. Anything about the physiotherapists' own timetables still comes through me.

Delivery rule: bulk deliveries (anything on a pallet, or more than a few boxes) come in through the loading bay at the back of Harbour Court, and we book them into our loading-bay slot on Monday mornings at 08:00, before the clinic opens at 08:30.
Welcome to Harbour Court. The loading bay is behind the building, off Mill Lane; drivers should ring the tenant they are delivering to when they arrive.
I can run your team's fire-safety training in Room 4 on Wednesday 18 November at 13:00. It takes about an hour and a half.
Booked Lena Ford's fire-safety training for the whole team in Room 4 on Wednesday 18 November at 13:00.
Quote: one pallet with 20 boxes of A4 printer paper and 6 toner cartridges, $340 delivered. We can come on any weekday morning you choose.
Ordered Brightline's pallet of printer paper and toner ($340) and booked it into our Monday loading-bay slot: Monday 23 November at 08:00.
Quote: 8 boxes of paper hand towels and 6 boxes of toilet rolls, $180 delivered. Tell us which morning suits you.
Ordered the Paperwise hand towels and toilet rolls (14 boxes, $180) and booked them into our Monday loading-bay slot on Monday 7 December at 08:00.
A reminder for tenants: as well as your Monday morning slots, the loading bay can be used on Friday afternoons from 14:00, by arrangement with me.
Quote: six waiting-room chairs and a reception stool, $820, delivered flat-packed on one pallet on the morning of your choice.
Ordered Oakline's six waiting-room chairs and reception stool ($820), on one pallet in our Monday loading-bay slot: Monday 14 December at 08:00.
Happy to do 07:45 starts on any weekday in December if you need someone in early to take in a delivery.
Put Sam on an early start at 07:45 on Monday 7 December, so he is at the back door to take in the Paperwise delivery when it arrives at 08:00.
Thanks for your order. Our driver will ring your front desk from the loading bay when he arrives.
The blind in Room 4 is fixed, so the fire-safety training can go ahead there.

A change to our delivery rule from Monday 30 November: the landlord is giving the loading bay over to the new bin collection on Monday mornings, so our bulk-delivery slot moves to Tuesday mornings at 08:00. Anything we have already booked for a Monday from 30 November onwards moves to the Tuesday of the same week, same time.
All set for Wednesday 18 November at 13:00 in Room 4. I'll bring the extinguishers for the demonstration.
To do: send Oakline the name and phone number of our delivery contact by 13 November. Not done yet.
Brightline confirmed the paper and toner pallet for Monday 23 November at 08:00.

records.title: Sam's early start for the Paperwise delivery

task: Please send Sam the details of his early start for the Paperwise delivery: which morning, and what time he needs to be in.
why: From 30 November the bulk-delivery slot moves from Monday to Tuesday morning at 08:00, and anything booked for a Monday from that date moves to the Tuesday of the same week (e18 amends e3). The $180 Paperwise order is small enough for the front desk to move (e1), and Sam's early start follows it as a front-desk shift Priya may move (e2): both go to Tuesday 8 December, REVISE. The $820 Oakline order also falls on a Monday after 30 November, but changing it needs Joanna's sign-off (e1): ASK. The Brightline pallet on Monday 23 November comes before the new rule starts: KEEP.
